notes.title: Age of Barbarians - The Comic Series
notes.content:
Hail Barbarians!

The savage world of Age of Barbarians expands with The Comic Series, now officially supported by our Patreon page!
Traverse the brutal lands of Atlan, where blood, iron, lust, and sorcery shape the destiny of warriors and kings. Follow the legendary adventures of King Xodan, Yanah the Oracle, Rahaan the Barbarian, and the stunning Princess Sheyna as they challenge tyrants, face prehistoric monsters, dark witches, and alien entities, while battling the all-powerful Sorcerer Gods, the ancient and cruel creators of Atlan.

https://www.patreon.com/c/ageofbarbarians

[b]A Cinematic Visual Experience:[/b]
The comic comes to life through a powerful fusion of 3D renders, photographs of real models, and custom AI graphics, refined with meticulous digital post-production. A unique approach that gives the pages a hyper-realistic and visceral look, transporting you to a raw sword & sorcery world that feels real.

[b]Dark Secrets and Savage Desires:[/b]
Age of Barbarians: The Comic Series goes beyond battles, exploring the forbidden secrets and primal passions of its heroes and villains. Feel the thrill of savage violence, breathe the scent of blood, and be overwhelmed by the brutal sensuality that permeates every corner of the lands of Atlan.

[b]New Pages Every Month:[/b]
Every month, new pages expand the epic, unveiling new horrors, wonders, and legends.

If you would like to join the project, and read a good Sword & Sorcery comic book with modern graphics but classic heart, you are more than welcome.

Crian Soft
Christian Fanucci

notes.title: Age of Barbarians Chronicles - Artworks
notes.content:
Hail Barbarians!
Below, we present some of the artwork created by Fanucci Christian for Age of Barbarians Chronicles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508360/7fc6113d6d94c0e950777cf35cede75150210061.jpg[/img]

[i]SORCERER'S PRISONER.[/i]
Sharin, the beautiful princess of Skar-Am, is the prisoner of the cruel sorcerer Zordax the Inhuman.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508360/42c8cc327d9ea0219bd7108788729dfdc728c354.png[/img]

[i]XODAN, THE RESCUE[/i]
Xodan the Hulslauker battled against alien abominations to rescue a young maiden from a dreadful fate!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508360/e823ddae9aa7396753f02879bc76fc327af023e1.png[/img]

[i]YANAH'S RESOLUTE STAND[/i]

Queen Yanah gazes from a distance at the menacing fortress of her arch-nemesis, Zordax, where her beloved daughter, Sharin, is held captive.

Wide-screen format images are available on our Patreon channel:

notes.title: Age of Barbarians Chronicles Release Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508360/f37c017cd985b3021c6b3707b7add9615f4d0e55.jpg[/img]

Dear Barbarians and supporters,

We want to share an important update regarding the release date of Age of Barbarians Chronicles. As we approach the intended launch date of November 15, we've been evaluating the current status of the game and its readiness for a successful release. After careful consideration and consultation with our marketing team, we have made the difficult decision to postpone the release.

Our marketing experts have emphasized the need for a well-planned and executed launch. Moreover, by delaying the release to a later date, we can ensure that every aspect of the game is polished, and any potential issues are addressed, providing you with a truly exceptional experience.

We understand that this news may be disappointing, but please know that it was made in the best interests of the game and our community. We value your support and want to deliver a game that is well worth the wait.

It's important to mention that Age of Barbarians Chronicles it's already available in Early Access on our Patreon platform, where you can explore it before the Steam release. Your continued support on Patreon is greatly appreciated.

https://www.patreon.com/ageofbarbarians

We apologize for any inconvenience this delay may cause and thank you for your understanding. We believe that taking the time to ensure the game is in its best possible state is the right decision for both our team and our community.

We will continue to provide updates on our progress as we work towards delivering an outstanding gaming experience.

Thank you for your patience and unwavering support.

notes.title: Exciting News for Age of Barbarians Chronicles Players!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508360/6d2ef7b7cb6c61bd1127ddf052aa36008c5abfbe.jpg[/img]

We're thrilled to announce that we're expanding our horizons! When Age of Barbarians Chronicles releases in October, it will be available in a total of eight languages, making the adventure even more accessible to gamers around the world. You'll be able to enjoy the game in:

Italian
English
Spanish
German
Russian
French
Simplified Chinese
Japanese

Dive into the rich lore of Atlan, embark on an epic journey, and experience the thrill in your preferred language. Get ready to explore the savage world of Age of Barbarians Chronicles like never before!

Stay tuned for more updates and continue shaping your adventure. Thank you for being a part of this incredible journey with us.

notes.title: Age of Barbarians Chronicles Trailer - Heroes of Atlan
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=BUr1VWNajbg;full][/previewyoutube]

Hail Barbarians!
We are thrilled to announce the much-awaited release of the brand-new video trailer for our action-packed RPG, "Age of Barbarians Chronicles"!

The Heroes of Atlan: Join the fearless heroes of Atlan on their quest to rescue Princess Sharin, the daughter of King Xodan and Queen Yanah, destined to fulfill an ancient prophecy that foretells the fall of the God Sorcerers. King Xodan, the savage barbarian; Queen Yanah, the enigmatic oracle warrior; Ronkundar, the sorcerer; and Gorlo, the dwarf pit fighter, must unite to save their beloved land from the clutches of darkness and impending doom.

Don't forget to put "like" to the video!
And to add the game to your Steam wishing list! ;)
